description: This file defines extension methods for configuring dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging within an ASP.NET Core application related to the Conduit project. It primarily adds services such as MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, security components, and logging setup.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring services, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures core application services including MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and security services.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT authentication parameters and adds the JWT bearer authentication scheme.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the logger factory.
